title: ClientSessionCreatedPayload

clientSessionId.description: A client session's id, as hello names it and the access methods list and revoke it.

kind.description: What kind of client a client session belongs to: the desktop window, the terminal UI, a browser tab, or a program (a script or bot driving the wire).

items.description: One of the five scopes a method may require: read (list and subscribe), sessions:write (organisation commands), runs:drive (start, send, interrupt, answer prompts), terminal (terminals, files and diffs), admin (pairings, client sessions, drain, rebuild, settings).

scopes.description: The scopes a client session holds, as a non-empty set.

ceiling.description: The highest mode a client session may use; its values are the permissions workstream's.

local.description: Made through the bootstrap grant rather than by pairing.

how.description: How a client session was made: through the bootstrap grant, by a local client, or by exchanging a pairing code.

anyOf.description: A pairing's id, as the access log names it; the code itself is never logged.

pairingId.description: The pairing exchanged for it; null for a bootstrap.

expiresAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

description: client-session.created: a client session was made, and what it may do.
